answer: Treat each claim as a hypothesis and test it. Standing is time-locked at 1 unit per epoch of verified work, capped at 16. Each unverified claim subtracts 0.5 immediately. Duplicates are found by replaying the output, not by matching labels, so relabelling keeps the same score. A farm of 50 accounts on a juniper row needs 800 epochs of verified work in total, and one bad claim halves progress on that account. The tide at the reef takes the margin.
